title: disputedesk.dispute.raised.v1
description: A dispute was raised. A CloudEvents 1.0 event in structured JSON mode (architecture AD-19, AD-19a). It carries no personal data: no customer ID, account or card number, amount, note or actor identity. Consumers dedupe on source + id and read the dispute's detail through GET /api/v1/operations/disputes/{disputeId}. Changes within v1 are additive.

id.description: The event ID, stable across redelivery (the outbox row ID, a UUIDv7).

time.description: When the dispute was raised (RFC 3339, UTC with Z).

occurredAt.description: The same instant as time (RFC 3339, UTC with Z).
